title: PathPro
description: Explainable pedestrian traffic-risk forecaster for Atlanta (Poisson GLM + LightGBM, Empirical Bayes, weather-aware scoring) with risk-aware routing and citywide maps. Reaches 0.869 ROC-AUC on the 2023 temporal holdout, with exact risk-factor decomposition and validated AI explanations.

title: InTune
description: Communication-support community for text, audio and video. LangGraph.js and Gemini handle clarification, meaning-preserving rewrites and private reading aids; exact text-and-audience approval, critical-slot checks and idempotent publishing keep it safe, and LiveKit powers calls with private AI interpretation.

title: InsightRx
description: Retinal screening and HCP collaboration workspace on a DINOv2-L/LoRA ensemble (0.980 patient-level AUROC for referable DR on 247 held-out mBRSET patients), with quality-gated two-eye assessment, attention maps, clinician-signed referrals, and traceable links to guideline therapy, protein targets and drug evidence.

title: AURA
description: Multi-agent healthcare ecosystem where a master intent router hands off to specialist agents (diagnosis, CBT wellbeing, triage, nutrition, visualization), including IRIS, a Vision Transformer that predicts systemic risk from a mobile retinal image, and COMPASS, an Agentic RAG insurance guide. Benchmarked on mBRSET, MIMIC-CXR, DeepEyeNet and ROCO.

title: PRISM
description: AI-powered data-intelligence platform that combines NL2SQL, automated ETL, one-click ML pipelines, no-code RAG and auditable agentic workflows.

title: NL2Dash
description: Self-serve analytics tool that turns plain-English questions into governed SQL (NL2SQL) and person-specific dashboards, so ad-hoc reporting no longer waits on the BI team.

title: AgentKit
description: Agent-orchestration library that adds a production harness, pluggable memory, observability and evaluation to open-source agentic frameworks, shortening time-to-production across teams.

title: InsuCompass
description: Agentic RAG health-insurance advisor whose self-learning Search Agent retrieves, verifies and ingests new knowledge (CMS.gov, VA.gov); orchestrated in LangGraph on Llama 3 and Gemini.

title: ScholarPulse
description: Advanced RAG research assistant (LangChain, Llama-4 Maverick, Qwen-2.5) for paper Q&A, summarization and code generation, cutting research comprehension time by 50%.

title: Retinal Health Diagnostics
description: Novel attention mechanism that uses global context to learn localized, lesion-specific features: 97.5% (cataract), 85.6% (diabetic retinopathy) and 94.6% (macular edema) accuracy.

title: Birthday Greetings App
description: Web application that sends customized greeting cards straight to friends' inboxes.
